name: Facebook Pages
summary: Publish to Facebook Pages, answer comments and messages, and read Page insights.

actions.name: List Pages
actions.description: Lists the Facebook Pages this account manages.

actions.name: List Page posts
actions.description: Lists recent posts on the Page.

params.name: after
params.description: Page token returned by the previous call

actions.name: Read Page insights
actions.description: Reads reach, engagement and follower metrics for the Page or a post.

params.name: postId
params.description: Post to read; omit for the whole Page

actions.name: Publish a Page post
actions.description: Publishes a post to the Page: text, a link, one or more photos, or a video. Can schedule it for later.

params.name: scheduledPublishTime
params.description: Publish later, between 10 minutes and 30 days from now

actions.name: Edit a Page post
actions.description: Changes the text of a post the Page published.

actions.name: Delete a Page post
actions.description: Permanently deletes a post from the Page.

actions.name: List comments
actions.description: Lists comments on a Page post.

params.name: after
params.description: Page token returned by the previous call

actions.name: Reply to a comment
actions.description: Replies publicly to a comment as the Page.

actions.name: Hide a comment
actions.description: Hides a comment from everyone except its author and their friends.

actions.name: Unhide a comment
actions.description: Makes a hidden comment visible again.

actions.name: Delete a comment
actions.description: Permanently deletes a comment on a Page post.

actions.name: List Messenger conversations
actions.description: Lists Messenger conversations with the Page and their latest messages.

params.name: after
params.description: Page token returned by the previous call

actions.name: Send a Messenger message
actions.description: Sends a Messenger message from the Page. Only inside the 24-hour messaging window that opens when the person last messaged the account.
